_comment: Copy to <ODYSSEUS_DATA_DIR>/mlx_autoserve.json. Maps a gateway model name to an MLX model the gateway will auto-serve (via mlx_lm.server) on first request. 'venv_bin' is the bin/ dir of a venv with mlx-lm installed; omit to use mlx_lm.server from PATH. Optional: ctx, priority (higher survives eviction), pin (bool), trust_remote (bool). A bare string value is treated as the repo_id.
